name: HiDAC (High-Dose Cytarabine consolidation)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
Corticosteroid eye drops during and after cytarabine to prevent chemical conjunctivitis.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.
Cerebellar/neurologic checks before each dose (hold for cerebellar toxicity).
Renal function (reduce dose in impairment and age >= 60).

drugs.name: Cytarabine (high-dose)
drugs.notes: 3000 mg/m2 IV over 3 h every 12 h on days 1, 3 and 5 (favorable-risk consolidation, typically 3-4 cycles). Reduce to 1000-1500 mg/m2 in patients age >= 60 or with renal impairment. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
